about: Places where Basel-Stadt's own 3D city model (MapBS 3D-Stadtmodell, Wavefront OBJ in LV95, ordered free from shop.geo.bs.ch on 18 October 2026) is newer than swissBUILDINGS3D, each checked against the SWISSIMAGE aerial photo the game lays on the ground and against the shadows in it. build_city.py drops the listed swissBUILDINGS3D buildings (gml ids) and puts the listed MapBS buildings (object names) in their place. A site is swapped whole or not at all. Everywhere else the two models agree to within a metre or so and the game keeps swissBUILDINGS3D.
